description: This header file declares the QLinearOnednnXPU class with static methods for quantized linear operations on tensors, including pointwise and binary variants, as well as packaging functions and dtype decision logic within the at::native::xpu namespace.

classes.name: QLinearOnednnXPU
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for quantized linear tensor operations optimized for XPU hardware.

methods.name: q_linear_pointwise
methods.description: Performs quantized linear pointwise operation with optional post-processing.

methods.name: q_linear_pointwise_tensor
methods.description: Performs quantized linear pointwise operation where scale and zero point are tensors.

methods.name: q_linear_pointwise_binary
methods.description: Performs quantized linear binary operation involving two tensors with support for post-ops.

methods.name: q_linear_pointwise_binary_tensor
methods.description: Performs quantized linear binary operation where involved tensors have scales and zero points as tensors.

methods.name: q_linear_prepack_onednn
methods.description: Prepares or packages weight tensor for optimized linear operations using OneDNN.

methods.name: qlinear_decide_out_dtype
methods.description: Decides the output data type for quantized linear operations based on input tensor and optional output dtype.
